name: Unicommerce Esolutions Ltd
title: Unicommerce Esolutions Ltd - 544227 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Software/SaaS for e-commerce ops: FY26 revenue +51.6% to INR204.3cr but Q4 standalone growth only 11.7% and management guides lower EBITDA for two quarters on investment, with no FY27 growth number given.

triggers.label: Near-term EBITDA/PAT to fall on investment
triggers.quote: You will see the near-term financial impact of these investments in the form of lower adjusted EBITDA and PAT over the next 2 quarters.

triggers.label: Uniware Q4 growth 11.7%
triggers.quote: Uniware delivered 11.7% growth in Q4, in line with our guidance during our last earnings call

triggers.label: Standalone ARPA fell 11% in FY26
triggers.quote: our ARPA fell by 11% in FY '26 higher -- slightly higher than FY '25

guidance.quote: we are confident of delivering a double-digit growth in Uniware
we remain confident of delivering higher full year operational profitability in FY '27 compared to FY '26
Shipway should also grow double digits year-on-year at a faster pace

red_flags.label: Top-10 customer revenue up ~3.5% only; one large customer churned
red_flags.quote: We've seen one of our large customers churn because of the change in the business model

red_flags.label: Standalone ARPA down 11% in FY26
red_flags.quote: our ARPA fell by 11% in FY '26

red_flags.label: Shipway not EBITDA positive; investment step-up
red_flags.quote: So in this quarter, we are not EBITDA positive in Shipway

red_flags.label: Shipway transaction metric dropped
red_flags.quote: we are no longer publishing the number of transactions or shipments

evasions.quote: it will be difficult for me to give a specific guidance
So in this quarter, we are not EBITDA positive in Shipway because those are the investments we are doing in to drive growth.
we are no longer publishing the number of transactions or shipments
it's difficult to give a specific guidance for business sensitive reasons
